'''Walter Gilman (Chapter 4)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[The Pharaoh's Awakening]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Focus]]
*+1 [[Lore]]

The investigator that has '''Walter Gilman''' can't get rid of his [[Curse]], but is not affected by [[The Dark Pharaoh]] - Blood Will Boil ability

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
